_note: Ep. 002 (Bitget), 20 illustrations, 22 Nov 2026. People only seen from behind / in silhouette, described positively (Z-Image: negations activate the concept). No text, no logos, no exact counts. Riskiest images first.

images.prompt: A person seen from behind, sitting at a cluttered desk in a dark rented room, only the back of the head and the shoulders visible as a dark silhouette, facing an open laptop whose cold screen glow outlines the shoulders, takeaway cups and tangled cables on the desk, a curtained window behind the laptop.

A smartphone lying on a wooden nightstand in a dark bedroom at night, its screen lit with a plain grey glow casting light on the wood, a rumpled bed and a dark window softly out of focus in the background.

A plain blank plastic staff card on a black lanyard, lying back side up on an empty office desk under a warm desk lamp, the card completely plain and smooth, a dark office softly out of focus behind it.

An empty open-plan trading office high in a tower at night, rows of dark desks and chairs, a single monitor still lit at the far end of the room, glittering city lights of an Asian metropolis through floor-to-ceiling windows.

Two tall glass office towers side by side against a deep night sky, the left tower completely dark, the right tower fully lit floor by floor in warm light, seen from street level looking up, light haze between them.
A classic ring lifebuoy hanging on a wooden post at the end of an empty dock at night, lit by a single warm lamp, calm dark water and fog behind it.

A sleek rack-mounted network security appliance in a dark server room, rows of servers fading into the background, one single small red indicator light glowing on the appliance, cold blue ambient light.
A worn brass key taped to the underside of a rubber doormat that is lifted at one corner, on the floor of a small security guard booth, CCTV monitors glowing softly in the background.
An empty security guard booth at night, a wall of glowing CCTV monitors showing grey empty corridors, an empty swivel chair turned slightly away from the desk, a cold cup of coffee on the desk.
A long dark office corridor lined with identical closed doors, one door near the end standing slightly ajar with warm amber light spilling out onto the floor.
A heavy old rubber stamp held in mid-air just above a blank sheet of paper on a dark wooden desk, lit by a single warm desk lamp, the paper plain and empty.
A vast empty trading floor at night, long rows of desks with multiple screens glowing dim blue, every chair empty, quiet and still, light haze in the air.
A dark operations control room, wall of large screens, a single red rotating alarm beacon on the ceiling casting red light across the empty desks.
A single fingerprint dusted with fine powder on a pane of dark glass, caught in the narrow beam of a flashlight, extreme close-up, everything else in darkness.
An investigation wall in a dark room, a large plain world map with pins and red thread connecting distant points, blank index cards, lit by a single warm lamp from the side.
A wide dark river at night seen from above, splitting into many smaller streams that spread out and disappear into mist, faint moonlight on the water.
A single gold coin sinking slowly into deep dark water, a few small bubbles, the surface faint above, fading into black below.
An unmanned border checkpoint at night, the boom barrier raised and left open, an empty lit booth, a straight empty road continuing into fog.
Inside a bank vault, metal shelves with neat stacks of gold bars on the lower shelves and empty upper shelves, lit by a warm overhead light, the heavy round vault door open at the side.
A heavy steel door with two separate keyholes one above the other, a key inserted in each lock, close-up, warm side light on brushed metal.
